messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — service=inference-runtime severity=P1. Elevated 5xx rate + latency spike in us-west-2. Incident ID: IR-37210. Link: https://pager.redwood/IR-37210
Maya: I'm on it, grabbing logs and KV cache stats.
Jordan: I'm taking the pager. Maya, can you dump the last 20m of metrics and a flamegraph?
Maya: running: kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-runtime --since=20m | grep -E 'kv_cache|batch' ; uploading to /tmp/ir-37210/logs
Sam: Observed cache-miss rate jump ~14:12 UTC: 2% -> 38%. Batching queue length spiked to 240.
Priya: Also seeing quantized model tails slower — quant_infer_time up ~200ms vs baseline. Recent quant changes landed in the last deploy.
Jordan: Immediate mitigations: rollback quant build to v1.4.2 and increase KV cache TTL to reduce thrash. Priya, can you trigger rollback and a TTL bump?
Priya: Starting rollback now: /deploy inference-runtime@v1.4.2 (CI: https://ci.redwood/12478)
ops-bot: Deploy started by Priya — job #12478.
Sam: Deploy progressing, prepping to tail logs and watch metrics.
Maya: After TTL bump + rollback, KV hit rate climbing back to ~87% within 4 minutes.
Jordan: Customer impact: a subset of requests experienced higher latency and some 5xx; affected customers count ~2.5%. Not a full outage but customer-facing degradation. Support notified.
Rafael: Opening a postmortem doc and triaging action items. Doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/IR-37210-postmortem
Jordan: Action items (short):
- A1: Confirm root cause: correlate quant patch with latency bump and cache eviction pattern — owner: Priya — ticket INF-3921
- A2: KV cache policy review (eviction thresholds / TTL defaults) + add guardrails — owner: Sam — ticket INF-3922
- A3: Batching backpressure protection (alert on queue depth + auto-shed logic) — owner: Maya — ticket INF-3923
- A4: Add canary/perf-smoke for quant builds (latency smoke + cache-interaction tests) — owner: Rafael — ticket INF-3924
Priya: I'll attach the exact diff that introduced the quant change and open INF-3921 now. Expect PR & rollback analysis by EOD.
Sam: I'll add alert: `alerts.kv_cache.queue_depth > 200 for 1m` and include runbook step for temporary TTL bump.
Maya: Scheduling postmortem review meeting — Thu 15:00 UTC. Please confirm availability.
Jordan: Available.
Rafael: Available.
Priya: Available.
Sam: Available.
Maya: Notes / logs snippet: ```
[14:12:03] kv_cache_miss=0.38 queue_len=245 batch_size=1 latency=520ms
[14:12:12] quant_infer_time=490ms model=llama-q8 quant_mode=8bit
```
Rafael: I'll prepare customer-facing summary for Support (short blurb + mitigation steps).
Jordan: Good. We'll track these in INF board and flag any blockers for the remediation sprint.
Priya: Opening PR for additional perf test harness (link to follow).
Sam: Updating monitoring dashboards and adding historical comparison panels.
Maya: I'll own verification that KV hit rate stays >85% for 24h and that no regression recurs. Will update INF-3922 daily.
ops-bot: Reminder set for postmortem review — Thu 15:00 UTC. Event: https://calendar.redwood/meet/pm-review-IR-37210
Jordan: Thanks all — marking pager acknowledged closed once deploy & monitoring validated. Please post any follow-ups here.
Maya: Will post remediation progress updates daily in this thread.
Priya: First update: INF-3921 created and PR in draft -> https://git.redwood/pr/5678 ; work in progress.
Rafael: Assigned INF-3924, will add canary design doc to the postmortem by EOD.
Sam: INF-3922 dashboards updated and alert PR open -> https://git.redwood/pr/5680
Maya: Closing note: no data corruption, customers notified, next review scheduled.
